suggestion: Store one team-stat snapshot per refresh run so estimator B can be scored out-of-sample after a few weeks.
why: Estimator B's log-loss is currently in-sample (flag 793-F-06). Daily snapshots make an honest expanding walk-forward possible, matching estimator A.
options: A: store snapshots forever; B: store a rolling window (e.g. 30 days); C: keep only the latest.
recommended_option: B — a rolling window keeps the repository small and is enough for walk-forward scoring.
dependency: The scheduled refresh job already writes data/app/refresh/<stamp>/; the snapshot step is a copy of the three pages into a dated file.

suggestion: Keep the projection/bet split enforced in CI: fail the build if a bet-surface page publishes a stake or odds figure while no strategy is funded.
why: The split is a hard requirement ('never mix them'). A CI assertion makes the rule mechanical rather than editorial.
options: A: lint rule in build_app.py; B: separate check script; C: rely on review.
recommended_option: A — build_app already fails on broken provenance; extending it to the surface rule keeps one gate.
dependency: Owner decision; small change to scripts/build_app.py.

suggestion: Run results_feed.py settle --date at each game day end from the workflow (a second cron after the last tip) so settlement stamps are automatic.
why: The brief asks for the sealed ledger to be settled from official finals at each game day end with a visible stamp. The command exists and is tested; scheduling it removes the manual step.
options: A: extra cron in refresh.yml; B: separate settle.yml; C: settle within the next morning's refresh.
recommended_option: B — a dedicated settle workflow at 06:00 UTC keeps the settle step visible and independently re-runnable.
dependency: Owner decision on timing; the settle command is idempotent (tested).
